equivalence.limitation: Sequential cached-mode runs; no filesystem cache flush; first query retained; ordinary host activity not controlled. Does not establish default auto freshness latency.

limitations: All variants use cached freshness; they do not establish default auto freshness latency.
Sequential runs retained the first query without flushing filesystem/page caches. Ordinary host activity and thermal conditions were not controlled.
Other indexing, model inference and build processes were paused during query timing; they may have affected memory/cache state before each run.
These 20-invocation samples are observed nearest-rank percentiles, not a release latency guarantee.
The recorded covering-index p95 is 2.821826 seconds, above the two-second target.
One synthetic vector per source document does not represent the chunk expansion or relevance of real repository history.

acceptance.note: Final auto timing is one diagnostic observation after the pending-check change, not a p95 estimate.
